note: Names are the 12 from the 8TO r2 spec section 4 (8SO list). Mutations were written by 8TO. 8SO may add, never remove; 8SO owns the final list.

faults.name: missing-estop
replace: safe := estop_ok AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok;

faults.name: double-driven-output
replace:
motor := run AND safe;
  IF stop THEN motor := FALSE; END_IF;

faults.name: output-stuck-after-input-loss
replace: safe := estop_ok AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok;
IF estop_ok AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok THEN safe := TRUE; END_IF;

faults.name: input-fault-not-safe
replace: safe := estop_ok AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok;

faults.name: stuck-output-ignores-off
replace: ELSIF stop THEN run := FALSE; count := 0;

faults.name: unbounded-loop-in-scan
replace:
WHILE count < 0 DO count := count + 1; END_WHILE;
  start_edge := start AND NOT start_prev;

faults.name: estop-in-one-branch
replace: IF NOT safe THEN run := FALSE; count := 0;
IF NOT safe AND NOT run THEN run := FALSE; count := 0;

faults.name: safe-state-one-scan-late
replace: safe := estop_ok AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok;

safe := estop_prev AND sensor_ok AND wd_ok;
  estop_prev := estop_ok;

safe : BOOL := FALSE;
    estop_prev : BOOL := TRUE;

faults.name: latch-survives-reset
replace: IF NOT safe THEN run := FALSE; count := 0;
